## `neuro.object.hasOwn`

Static method on `Object`.

> Determines whether an object has a property with the specified name.

## Signatures

```ts
hasOwn(input: { o: object; v: PropertyKey; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.hasOwn` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
